pages.text: Mila opens her closet and sees many choices: shirts, pants, jackets, and boots.
On a hot day, she chooses light cotton clothes that feel cool.
When it is cold, she adds layers: sweater, coat, hat, and scarf.
When rain comes, she wears a raincoat and boots to stay dry.
At a community festival, families wear special outfits for the celebration.
Mila sees bright patterns, careful stitching, and fabrics from family traditions.
She learns some special clothes are worn on holidays, weddings, or dances.
A friend explains the story behind their outfit, and Mila listens politely.
Mila remembers to ask before touching anyone's clothes.
At night she says: clothes can keep us safe and also share culture.
